changelog.name: 1.58.617 (vC899)
changelog.body:
A major update to lyric sources, layout customization, and how you use lyrics outside the fullscreen view.

- **live layout editor:** adjust artwork, song information, lyric placement, controls, and the now-playing card directly on screen. Changes save immediately, with landscape and foldable layouts.
- **picture-in-picture lyrics:** keep lyrics visible while using another app, with selectable window shapes and optional playback controls. Enable the PiP button in Settings.
- **rebuilt lyric source management:** saved lyrics and source choices now live in a persistent song catalog. Check individual sources, select a saved version, or let Auto compare enabled sources. Source status updates without reopening the picker.
- **more lyric sources:** optional QQ Music and NetEase searches.
- **lyric share cards:** long-press to select lines and share them as an image. Enable the sharing gesture in Settings.
- **updated visuals:** reworked Apple-style motion, artwork-based mesh backgrounds, custom fonts, and more control over lyric-follow behavior.
- **interface updates:** Japanese and Korean translations, plus reorganized settings.
- **one APK:** replaces the separate Full and Lite downloads. Language models download separately from Settings.

Install over your existing version, then force-stop and reopen Spotify.

**Download language models in Settings to enable readings.**

- More reliable loading and no-lyrics state handling.

HyperGlow is a separate root/LSPosed module, currently tested on Xiaomi 14 running HyperOS 3.

readme:
# Spicy EX Spicy Lyrics for Spotify, as an Xposed/LSPosed module.
## Features - Full-screen synced lyrics — Spicy karaoke wash, per-word animation, interludes. - Live current line in the player, with a ♪ placeholder on no-lyric tracks. - Transliteration: Japanese (furigana / romaji / both), Chinese (pinyin / jyutping), Korean / Cyrillic / Greek — optionally per-word. - Google Translate. - In-Spotify settings; works even when Spotify itself has no lyrics. ## Install APK from [Releases](../../releases). **Rooted (LSPosed):** install, enable, scope to Spotify — you know the drill. **Non-rooted (LSPatch):** Spotify enforces Play Integrity during login. Bypass this using the **Downgrade-Login-Upgrade** method: 1. Download two Spotify APKs: an older version (e.g., `v8.9.18`) and the target version (`v9.1.28.2252`). 2. Patch both APKs with Spicy EX using [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) (ensures matching signatures). 3. **Uninstall** current Spotify and **install the patched OLD version**. 4. **Log in** (Email/Password only, no Google/Facebook). 5. **Install the patched NEW version** over the old one as an update. > [!NOTE] > Tested on Spotify **v9.1.28.2252**. > [!WARNING] > May conflicts with ReVanced / modified Spotify or old Spotify Plus ## Build JDK 21, Android SDK. ```sh ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` ## Credits - [LeNerd46/SpotifyPlus](https://github.com/LeNerd46/SpotifyPlus) - [Spikerko/Spicy Lyrics](https://github.com/Spikerko/spicy-lyrics) - [surfbryce/beautiful-lyrics](https://github.com/surfbryce/beautiful-lyrics) - [boidushya/better-lyrics](https://github.com/boidushya/better-lyrics) (+ kawarp background) ## License [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE). See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for attribution.
